title: Gate Two-Tier Verify Before Block (T1)
desc: T1 core: two-tier verify-before-block for harness gates with indexer timing uncertainty. T1 quick then T2 stronger before confirmed block. Implementation -> gate-two-tier-verify-howto; history -> gate-two-tier-verify-ref.
steps: WHY: harness gates querying an indexer (wkhippo studied-index, JSONL scanner) have TIMING GAPS. Compaction boundaries advance between tool calls, making same-session reads appear stale. Result: false-blocks on compliant sessions. The two-tier pattern prevents this. PATTERN: T1 quick with Since=MAX(session.CreationTime, recentCompaction) and -LimitPaths to current session JSONL. If T1 finds all required ids then COMPLIANT. If T1 misses go to T2 stronger with no -Since and same -LimitPaths. If T2 finds then COMPLIANT plus log gate-name-indexer-timing-gap to stderr. If both miss then confirmed block. SCOPE: -LimitPaths to current session JSONL gives implicit 1-day search limit. Never run unbounded all-session index search. FAMILY-AWARE: compaction markers differ per family. Since computation must branch on modelFam (Claude vs Codex vs Gemini vs Agy). FAIL-SAFE: when Get-WkStudiedFromIndex unavailable fall through to Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds same-turn fallback. Never fail-closed when scanner absent. NAVIGATION: implementation code and param combinations in gate-two-tier-verify-howto; origin session and design history in gate-two-tier-verify-ref.

requirements.expect: WHY: harness gates with indexer timing uncertainty MUST use two-tier verify-before-block
